pages.text: $(l)Mana Rebirth$() grants a resurrection effect similar to a Totem of Undying, powered by Botania mana.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 5$(br)$(l)Type:$() Healing/Utility$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 50,000 + 25,000/level$(br2)When active, prevents death by consuming Botania mana (configurable cost, default 100,000). Heals you to 30% HP (configurable) with a dramatic visual effect. The buff lasts until triggered or it expires.

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Epic Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Mana Rebirth$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
